faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for the JRF recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is managed by the Islamic University of Science & Technology, Kashmir (IUST) for an AYUSH sponsored research project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this IUST notification?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class Post-Graduate (PG) degree such as M.Sc. or equivalent with specialization in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Botany, or Pharmacology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the monthly salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 31,000/- plus 9% HRA as per guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. When does the online application process start and end?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 01 October 2026 and the last date to submit the online form is 11 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for General and EWS category candidates applying for the JRF position is 30 years as per the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any age relaxations provided for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided: up to 33 years for OBC candidates and up to 35 years for SC, ST, Differently Abled, and Women candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IUST JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting of candidates followed by a personal interview conducted by the university authorities.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an application fee for applying to this position?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification released by the Islamic University of Science & Technology.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply and find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website www.iust.ac.in and download the notification PDF from the Important Links section.
